prompt_kinds.short: One factual question with a short answer. Shows whether a style stays short on a small answer.
prompt_kinds.review-project: Open-ended review of the whole project. Shows structure and length on a long answer.
prompt_kinds.review-pr: Review one pull request at the pinned ref. Verdict plus findings by severity.
prompt_kinds.find-issues: Find bugs and risks in one area. Each finding as location, cause, fix.
prompt_kinds.critique-readme: Critique the README as a first-time contributor.
